subject: biology

hotspots.label: Fruiting body
hotspots.description: The mushroom part above ground - the reproductive spore-producing body of the fungus.
hotspots.positionHint: The mushroom cap and stalk standing above the soil.

hotspots.label: Mycelium
hotspots.description: The weblike network of fine threads under the soil - the main body of the fungus.
hotspots.positionHint: The network of fine threads spread under the lifted soil.

hotspots.label: Hypha (thread)
hotspots.description: A single thin thread of the fungus that makes up the mycelium network.
hotspots.positionHint: One long thin line branching in the web.
hotspots.function: Single tube of the fungus that spreads and absorbs.

hotspots.label: Spores
hotspots.description: Tiny reproductive specks a fungus releases that grow into new fungi.
hotspots.positionHint: Small dots drifting away from beneath the mushroom cap.

hotspots.label: Yeast (single cell)
hotspots.description: A separate tiny single-celled fungus, like yeast used to make bread rise.
hotspots.positionHint: A small separate cell placed apart from the mushroom for clarity.

visualStyleNotes: Anatomy Atelier bar throughout: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. A calm diorama - a clean mushroom over parted warm soil with a muted under-mycelium web. Warm cream, muted earth tones, no gamey glow. Strong saturated color reserved for the small hotspot dots.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0, matte roughness ~0.55-0.65. No emissive.
assetBrief: SUBJECT: a cross-view diorama, a clean stylized mushroom standing over a patched soil, with the soil partially lifted to reveal a netted web of fine hyphae (the mycelium) underneath. Tiny spore specks drift from under the cap. A separate small oval marks yeast. Named nodes: Mushroom, MyceliumWeb, Hypha, SporeDots, YeastCell. Budget 12-16k.
